mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 2.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window during non-recession periods, or SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of such instances with positive INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as long as RSAFS remains above $450k.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating rising inflation expectations, and FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low UNRATE (< 4%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, due to the predictive power of labor market strength on economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances with UNRATE below 4%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery regimes, a monthly increase in RSAFS, signaling improved consumer spending, enhances S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only if GDPC1 is also positive.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly change > 0 and GDPC1 quarterly change > 0
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window during post-shock recovery, or SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of triggered instances.
